stories.title: Parrot Sound Actions - Basic Hiss/Shush Integration
stories.description: Implement initial parrot sound integration for MouseClock. Map hiss to widen radius and shush to narrow radius. Only active when MouseClock is showing.
acceptanceCriteria: Hiss sound triggers mouse_clock_widen action
Shush sound triggers mouse_clock_narrow action
Actions only fire when user.mouse_clock_showing tag is active
Debounce prevents rapid-fire from sustained sounds
Minimum 150ms interval between accepted sound events
stories.info: See FEATURES.md 'Parrot Sound Actions Integration' section

stories.title: Parrot Sound Actions - Configurable Mapping
stories.description: Extend parrot integration with configurable sound-to-action mapping. Allow users to customize which sounds trigger which actions and with what parameters.
acceptanceCriteria: Sound mappings stored in configuration (dict or settings file)
Parameters adjustable per action (e.g., hiss_widen_amount = 15)
New sound mappings can be added without code changes
Voice command to reload/reset sound mappings

stories.title: Parrot Sound Actions - Configurable Mapping
stories.description: Extend parrot integration with configurable sound-to-action mapping. Allow users to customize which sounds trigger which actions and with what parameters.
acceptanceCriteria: Sound mappings stored in configuration (dict or settings file)
Parameters adjustable per action (e.g., hiss_widen_amount = 15)
New sound mappings can be added without code changes
Voice command to reload/reset sound mappings

stories.title: Lettered Line Overlay - Core Drawing
stories.description: Implement horizontal line overlay system. Divide screen into lettered bands (A-E or similar), draw horizontal lines when activated by voice command.
acceptanceCriteria: Screen divided into configurable number of horizontal bands
Each band assigned a letter (A, B, C, D, E)
Voice command 'line <letter>' draws horizontal line at that band's Y position
Line spans full viewport width
Line has configurable color and thickness
stories.info: See FEATURES.md 'Lettered Line Intersection Overlay' section

stories.title: Lettered Line Overlay - Vertical Intersections
stories.description: Add vertical intersection lines that appear after a horizontal line is active. Color-coded verticals help identify specific intersection points.
acceptanceCriteria: After horizontal line activated, vertical guides appear
Verticals are color-coded for identification
Verticals can be toggled on/off independently
Intersection points clearly marked with dots or crosses

stories.title: Spiral Nudge - Core Movement
stories.description: Implement spiral nudge cursor movement. Move mouse stepwise in expanding spiral pattern from starting point, useful for fine-grained targeting.
acceptanceCriteria: Spiral maintains state: origin point, current position, step count
Each nudge moves cursor to next point on spiral
Spiral expands outward with configurable step size and growth rate
Direction (clockwise/counterclockwise) is configurable
Maximum radius prevents cursor from drifting too far

stories.title: Spiral Nudge - Sound Triggers
stories.description: Integrate spiral nudge with parrot sounds. Hiss advances spiral outward, shush reverses or pauses.
acceptanceCriteria: Hiss triggers spiral advance (next position)
Shush pauses, reverses, or steps inward
Debounce prevents runaway motion
Only active when a targeting overlay is showing

stories.title: Concentric Box - Core Rendering
stories.description: Implement concentric rectangle overlay as alternative to circles. Render axis-aligned boxes centered at cursor, each with distinct color.
acceptanceCriteria: Configurable number of concentric boxes (e.g., 5)
Each box has distinct color from COLOR_REGISTRY
Boxes are axis-aligned rectangles or squares
Size progression is configurable (linear or geometric)
Boxes render centered at cursor position

stories.title: Concentric Box - Directional Guides
stories.description: Add clock-style directional rays that intersect the boxes. Thin dashed lines at each clock hour angle help identify intersection points.
acceptanceCriteria: 12 directional rays drawn at clock-hour angles
Rays are thin and dashed (visual guides only)
Intersection points with boxes clearly marked
Optional labels at intersections or box boundaries

stories.title: Concentric Box - Target Computation
stories.description: Implement ray-rectangle intersection for targeting. Given (direction, box color) pair, compute and move to intersection point.
acceptanceCriteria: Voice command '<color> <letter>' targets box-direction intersection
Voice command '<color> <number>' works with numeric clock positions
Ray-rect intersection handles all angles correctly (edges and corners)
Cursor moves to computed intersection point
